source: Yahoo Finance v8 chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com), daily OHLCV bars since 2000 (or the instrument's first trading day); completed days only. P/E arrays: daily close / trailing-twelve-month diluted EPS from SEC EDGAR companyfacts, point-in-time by first filing date, each period taken from its original filing and split-adjusted to the prices' basis. Buy/sell arrays: Johnny's indicator signal dates, computed from these bars, P/E arrays and the VIX series
